summary: Beam Global filed an 8-K under Item 1.02 reporting the termination of a material definitive agreement — specifically, the lease for its San Diego headquarters. On April 27, 2026, landlord PNN Holdings, LP gave written notice that it terminated the lease, which had been extended on January 26, 2026, and was set to expire September 30, 2026. The termination is effective July 26, 2026, with no material early termination penalties. The company does not expect a material adverse effect on operations and is evaluating new headquarters options. This is a routine contract termination, not a special situation.
